# Godot 场景与游戏循环知识图谱

## 总览：场景管理与信号流 [BV1zaNX6fEbm P1 00:05] [BV1zaNX6fEbm P1 04:03] [BV1zaNX6fEbm P1 09:32]
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    ST["场景树 (根节点)"]
    TS["Title Screen 场景"]
    LV["Level1 场景"]
    WS["Win Screen 场景"]
    QG["Quit Game (退出)"]
    SB["Start Game 按钮"]
    RB["Return to Menu 按钮"]
    QB["Quit Game 按钮"]
    SigStart["Press 信号 (Start)"]
    SigReturn["Press 信号 (Return)"]
    SigQuit["Press 信号 (Quit)"]

    ST --> TS
    TS --> SB
    SB --> SigStart
    SigStart --> LV
    LV --> WS
    WS --> RB
    RB --> SigReturn
    SigReturn --> TS
    WS --> QB
    QB --> SigQuit
    SigQuit --> QG
```

## UI 场景构建步骤 [BV1zaNX6fEbm P1 00:55] [BV1zaNX6fEbm P1 02:18] [BV1zaNX6fEbm P1 03:12]
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    CT["创建 Title Screen (User Interface 模板)"]
    ATL["添加 Label 节点"]
    STL["设置 Label Text 为 'game title'"]
    ATB["添加 Button 节点"]
    STB["设置 Button Text 为 'Start Game'"]
    ST["保存 Title Screen 到 CNS 文件夹"]

    CW["创建 Win Screen (User Interface 模板)"]
    AWL["添加 Label 节点"]
    SWL["设置 Label Text 为 'UN'"]
    AWRB["添加 Return to Menu Button"]
    SRB["设置 Button Text 为 'return to menu'"]
    SW["保存 Win Screen 到 CNS 文件夹"]

    CWind["创建 Wind Screen (User Interface 模板)"]
    AWindL["添加 Label 节点"]
    SWindL["设置 Label Text 为 'UN'"]
    AQuitB["添加 Quit Game Button"]
    SQuitB["设置 Button Text 为 'quit game'"]
    SWind["保存 Wind Screen 到 CNS 文件夹"]

    CT --> ATL --> STL --> ATB --> STB --> ST
    CW --> AWL --> SWL --> AWRB --> SRB --> SW
    CWind --> AWindL --> SWindL --> AQuitB --> SQuitB --> SWind
```

    SB["Start Game 按钮"]
    LV["Level1 场景"]
    CC["收集金币"]
    VC["胜利条件检测"]
    WS["Win Screen"]
    RB["Return to Menu 按钮"]
    QB["Quit Game 按钮"]

    TS --> SB
    SB --> LV
    LV --> CC
    CC --> VC
    VC -->|成功| WS
    WS --> RB
    RB --> RT
    WS --> QB
    QB --> QG
    RT --> TS
```
